title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E10 — Tim Conway, Stiller & Meara
Tim Conway's a burger clown and a baseball team coordinator; Stiller & Meara do a dentist skit and a police line-up.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E11 — Burns & Schreiber, The Fifth Dimension
Rev. Leroy visits a monastery; Burns & Schreiber improvise machines and Fifth Dimension members do a dating sketch with Flip.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E13 — Ted Knight, The Pointer Sisters, Chuck Norris, Phillip Paley
Ted Knight's a news anchor; Flip gets flipped by Phillip Paley (9-year old karate kid) with Chuck Norris; the Pointers join Rev. Leroy.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E17 — McLean Stevenson, Redd Foxx, Don Adams
Flip & Don gamble in Las Vegas; Redd Foxx does stand-up and Q&A; three guys celebrate their wives going out of town.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E10 — Gladys Knight and the Pips
One of the great Motown acts of the past several years headlines the show, performing the hit, "I Heard It through the Grapevine.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E11 — Al Green
Highlights feature guest Al Green singing "Let's Stay Together" and author Verta Mae Grosvenor reading form her latest book, Thursdays and Every Other Sunday Off.
